task.summary: The target video is a handheld documentary sequence in a glassblowing atelier at dusk. <Subject 1> speaks one line in French to <Subject 2> across a cooling bench while the furnace glow moves across both faces; an English subtitle carries the translation. Three shots: a two-shot establishing the bench, a close single on <Subject 1> as she speaks, and a reverse on <Subject 2> listening in silence.

shots.camera: handheld medium two-shot, slight breathing motion, the camera settling as it finds the bench
shots.action: <Subject 1> stands at the left of a long steel cooling bench in a dim workshop, <Subject 2> opposite her at the right, a row of cooling glass vessels between them catching orange light from an open furnace mouth in the deep background.

events.requirement: Neither figure speaks in this shot and both keep their lips closed; the only sound is the room.

shots.closing: Heat shimmer rises off the bench between them and warm light crawls across the vessels.

shots.camera: cut to a handheld close single on <Subject 1>, shallow focus, the furnace glow warm on the left side of her face
shots.action: <Subject 1> lifts her eyes from the glass and looks directly across the bench.

events.speaker: <Subject 1>
events.words: Il faut le laisser refroidir jusqu'a demain.
events.delivery: speaks quietly and evenly, barely above the furnace noise
events.mouth: her lips moving clearly with the words
events.lead: Facing <Subject 2> across the bench, <Subject 1> speaks quietly and evenly

events.prose_request: A single-line English subtitle is burned into the lower third of the frame, centred, in a plain white sans-serif with a soft dark drop shadow, appearing as she begins to speak and clearing as she finishes.
events.text: We have to let it cool until tomorrow.
events.layout: lower third, centred, plain white sans-serif with a soft dark shadow, one line

shots.closing: She lowers her eyes back to the glass as the line ends.

shots.camera: cut to a handheld reverse close single on <Subject 2>, the furnace behind him thrown far out of focus
shots.action: <Subject 2> listens without answering, then gives a single slow nod and reaches to draw a cloth over the nearest vessel.

events.requirement: <Subject 2> does not speak and his lips remain completely closed throughout the shot.

shots.closing: The cloth settles and the orange light on his face dims as the furnace mouth swings shut.

sound.overall: A low continuous furnace roar sits under the whole sequence, close and slightly muffled, with the fine tick of cooling glass in the near foreground. One line of quiet French speech sits clearly above the room tone in the middle of the sequence. A soft cloth drag and the heavy swing of an iron door close the sequence.
sound.non_diegetic: None. The sequence carries room sound only.
